RatioNotLowerThanBefore (0x0c1c9c40), TargetRatioMiss (0xf2b69436), SlippageHitError (0x16437be0) and ZeroTokensSwapped (0x6a756fbe) appear nowhere in the text, so the safety checks of the boost are lost; ActionEvent is emitted only on the paths that avoid them.

findings.issue: RAY, RAY / 2, WAD / 2 and 1e8 print as products (1000000000 * 10**18, 500000000 * 10**18, 5 * 10**17, 100 * 10**6), and the uint80 range checks of the oracle answer print as slice comparisons.
findings.rule: Print a constant k * 10**n in its shortest normal form (10**27, 5 * 10**26, 10**8); x == x[22 len 10] of a word is x == uint80(x).

notes: The pack's sources for McdBoostComposite's own functions (executeAction*, _boost, _drawDebt, parseCompositeParams) are taken from LlamaLendSelfLiquidateWithColl.sol (a source-unit mix-up of the pack); the review used the real contracts/actions/mcd/McdBoostComposite.sol. The only source loop the pack lists (TxSaverBytesTransientStorage.setBytesTransiently, for i < chunks) is not in this bytecode: getBytesTransiently is an external call on another contract, so source_loops = 0. The 88 whiles are all implicit: 84 memory-to-memory copies of bytes (abi.decode of the BoostParams/ExchangeData bytes members, encoding of call buffers, including a fixed 'while idx < 68' copy of overlapping ranges) counted as P7, and 4 validated ABI decodes (uint8[]/address[] with a require per element). The getters, the price/oracle helpers, getCdpInfo, getRatio, getUrnAndIlk, withdrawStuckFunds, calcGasCost read; executeAction (4729 lines) and executeActionDirect (2667) reviewed by structure. getChainlinkPriceInUSD's self-call is printed as the recursive internal_0x12dc (good). The 17 constant getters are the 'const' lines at the head of the text. Custom errors not in the signature database print as selectors (0xf1474319 TokenDecimalsUnsupportedError, normal). The memory zeroing of the BoostParams struct (2274-2297...) and decoded fields as memory slices (P8, P18) dominate the start of both execute functions.
summary: The view helpers are exact and readable, but the two execute functions lose 23 paths (the post-swap and post-boost checks never appear) and are dominated by 84 memory-copy whiles, P2 calls and memory-slice struct fields.
